title: Best Yoga Mats in India (2026)
summary: Three Decathlon India yoga mats: light 5 mm, soft 8 mm and grippy 4 mm. Based on shop pages and maker text. Not hand-tested.
description: Helps anyone in India choosing a yoga mat. Three Decathlon picks, plus plain tips on thickness, material, grip and size.
lead: Which yoga mat should you buy in India? Here are three picks. One is a light 5 mm mat that is easy to carry. One is a soft 8 mm mat for gentle floor work. One is a grippy 4 mm mat for flowing styles. All three are from Decathlon India, because its pages state the thickness, size and stock clearly. We have not hand-tested any of them. This guide uses the shop pages, the maker's own words and general buying advice.

picks.label: Suits light carrying
cells: EVA and polyethylene foam (per the page)
Starting out and carrying to class
picks.verdict: A plain, light 5 mm mat with a built-in strap. The maker calls the grip light, so it may suit gentle practice more than sweaty sessions.
paragraphs: The Decathlon India page lists this mat as 5 mm thick and 180 x 58 cm. The page gives the material as 53% ethylene vinyl acetate (EVA), 27% thermoplastic polyethylene and 20% polyethylene. The maker says it weighs 600 g and has a built-in strap. It also says the light grip suits all styles of yoga and the surface is good for starting out.

The page shows the mat as in stock. It shows a 2-year warranty. The return text says 14 days for online orders and 30 days for store purchases. The page shows a rating of 4.6 from 670 reviews. We did not read the review text, so we cannot say what buyers praise or complain about.

choose.heading: Pick the thickness for your floor and style
choose.text: Decathlon's own guide says thickness decides comfort. If a mat is too thin, your joints may feel the floor. If it is too thick, you may not feel a firm link with the floor. It suggests 3 to 5 mm for dynamic yoga and 5 to 8 mm for gentle yoga. Wikipedia says mats with more padding suit slower styles such as yin yoga. These are general views, not test results.

choose.heading: Know your material
choose.text: Wikipedia says PVC mats are the spongiest, rubber mats are firm, heavy and durable, and TPE mats are firm and very light. The three picks here use EVA foam, PVC foam and rubber foam with a PU top. Read the material line on the product page, because the name alone may not tell you.

choose.heading: Look at the grip
choose.text: Decathlon's guide says a sticky mat keeps you from sliding between poses. The maker calls the 4 mm Kimjaly very grippy and the 5 mm Domyos light grip. If you sweat a lot, grip may matter more to you than thickness.

choose.heading: Check the size if you are tall
choose.text: The three picks are 173 to 185 cm long. Decathlon India also lists a 5 mm mat of 200 x 75 cm that it says is made for taller people. We did not review it in detail.

choose.heading: Think about weight if you carry it
choose.text: Decathlon's guide says weight matters if you carry your mat often. Of our picks, only the 5 mm Domyos has a weight on its page (600 g, from the maker). Decathlon India also lists a 1.3 mm foldable travel mat that the maker says weighs 950 g.

choose.heading: Check the seller and return terms
choose.text: On the Decathlon India pages we read, the return text says 14 days for online orders and 30 days for store purchases. The pages also show a 2-year warranty. Terms can change, so read them on the page before you pay.

faq.q: What thickness of yoga mat should I choose?
faq.a: It depends on your floor and style. Decathlon's guide suggests 3 to 5 mm for dynamic yoga and 5 to 8 mm for gentle yoga. Thicker mats give more padding. But Decathlon says a mat that is too thick can weaken your feel of the floor.

faq.q: Which of these three is the lightest?
faq.a: The 5 mm Domyos is the only one with a stated weight, 600 g according to the maker. The other two pages do not state a weight, so we cannot compare them.

faq.q: Is a PU top layer more grippy?
faq.a: The maker says the PU top layer on the 4 mm Kimjaly gives maximum grip. That is the maker's claim. We have not tested it, so check buyer reviews on the page.

faq.q: What are the return terms on Decathlon India?
faq.a: On the pages we read, the return text says 14 days for online orders and 30 days for store purchases. The pages also show a 2-year warranty. Terms can change, so read them on the page before you buy.

faq.q: I am tall. Is there a longer mat?
faq.a: Our three picks are 173 to 185 cm long. Decathlon India also lists a 5 mm foam mat of 200 x 75 cm that the maker says is made for taller people.
